facts.fact: ARICEA's own presentation names Sudan as a member of the Executive Committee of the Association of Regulators of Information and Communications for Eastern and Southern Africa, launched January 2003 under COMESA; the document gives no date for Sudan joining, so the published date is used.

ARICEA states that Sudan, with Burundi and Zimbabwe (Broadcasting Authority), held a member seat on its five-seat Executive Committee, alongside Ethiopia (Chairman) and Uganda (Vice Chairman); the document gives no date for winning the seat, so the published date is used.
